lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two posterior-most lines are fragmented into discrete circular spots near the ventral boundary; the anterior-most line terminates prematurely before reaching the ventral mane.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 11-13 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lateral haunch, superior to the calcaneal tendon region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A row of 4 distinct spots aligns horizontally across the mid-haunch, parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate spiral geometry, emerging at an approximate 40-degree angle from the skull ridge before curving medially at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal horn tips is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of the left horn base in this 2D projection.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory-toned tipping constitutes approximately 14% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White v-shaped chevron present between the eyes; prominent white transverse band on the lower neck; distinct orange-to-tan transition on all four lower limbs below the knee/hock.
